title: ConfluenceScore
description: DecisionAgent's scoring output. See SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6. This is a decision-quality measure, not a win-probability estimate. Scoring is normalized against the ENGAGED-dimension maximum (engaged_count x 25), not a flat /100 total -- capping every dimension at a flat 25/100 made STRICT mode's 85 threshold mathematically unreachable with only 3 dimensions engaged (3x25=75 max); see SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.2 for the corrected formula.

mode_locked_at.description: Mode-lock rule: recorded before any dimension is analyzed and immutable for this run -- never downgraded after the fact to force a pass.

engaged_count.description: number of dimensions with eligible=true; denominator for raw_pct is engaged_count x 25

wyckoff.description: Wyckoff dimension. OWNS Volume Profile (VAH/VAL/LVN/VPOC) per user decision 2026-09-10 (knowledge/integrated/method.md section 7 decision 1, option B), matching where knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md section 5 Step 4 places it in the author's own method. The VAL/VAH-into-LVN abandon rule is a thesis invalidation, not a score input.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension scores. Wyckoff and ICT are NOT independent by default: `knowledge/ict/core-a.md`–`knowledge/ict/models.md` contain no volume, so the two dimensions largely read the same price geometry (knowledge/integrated/wyckoff-ict-mapping.md, knowledge/integrated/method.md section 4.1). Before both score one location or one structural break, StructureAgent must print both derived prices and state whether they differ by more than analysis-params.json project_defined.same_level_tolerance_atr.

contradictions.description: Anti-cherry-picking rule: this array must include contradictions found in EVERY dimension whose data source is AVAILABLE, not only the engaged/counted dimensions -- an available-but-unused dimension's contradictions still apply their full penalty.

category.description: shakeout_vs_displacement = the unresolved Wyckoff-vs-ICT case at knowledge/integrated/method.md section 4.5. wyckoff_ict_same_level = the two dimensions were reading one phenomenon at one price (knowledge/integrated/method.md section 4.3); raise it rather than scoring both.

raw_pct.description: (sum of points across engaged dimensions / (engaged_count x 25)) x 100; 0 if engaged_count is 0

penalty_total.description: percentage points, e.g. -15, subtracted from raw_pct -- not raw points

dimension_count_met.description: true only if engaged_count meets the active mode's minimum -- evaluated independently of final_score

unresolved_high_impact_contradictions.description: count of HIGH-impact contradictions still unresolved after Contradiction Analysis; STRICT mode additionally requires this to be 0 (SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 6.1)

verdict.description: TRADE requires threshold_met AND dimension_count_met AND no blocking event-risk-window contradiction; in STRICT mode also unresolved_high_impact_contradictions == 0

eligible.description: MAY THIS LANE COUNT TOWARD THE SCORE? true only when BOTH hold: (a) the active method preset ENGAGES it -- methods.dispatch_plan(instrument)['engaged'] -- and (b) its data source is AVAILABLE (not MOCK/STALE/UNAVAILABLE). Clause (a) is CLAUDE.md §18 ('Confluence must only include explicitly configured methodologies'; 'Do not count unrelated methodology analysis'); clause (b) is §6/§20. Before 2026-09-18 this field named only (b), which was accidentally safe because an untraded lane was also unanalysed -- §15 ended that coincidence, so a lane that is READ but not TRADED (analysis_scope 'available') now satisfies (b) while failing (a) and must score 0. Checked by scripts/confluence.py.
